An '''emergency survival pack''' was a piece of equipment stored aboard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] in case of emergency. [[Stevan Makintay]] procured several when he was hiding aboard a [[Unidentified Imperial transport (Hargeeva)|transport]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
